findings.rule: CIS-4.9 — Image not pinned to digest
findings.message: Base image 'node:20-alpine' uses a mutable version tag without a SHA digest. The tag can be silently re-pointed to a different image layer.
findings.remediation: Pin to a full digest, e.g. FROM node:20-alpine@sha256:<digest>. Retrieve the current digest with: docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' node:20-alpine

findings.rule: CIS-4.9 — Image not pinned to digest
findings.message: Base image 'python:3.11-slim' uses a mutable version tag without a SHA digest. The tag can be silently re-pointed to a different image layer.
findings.remediation: Pin to a full digest, e.g. FROM python:3.11-slim@sha256:<digest>. Retrieve the current digest with: docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' python:3.11-slim

findings.rule: CICD-003 — Unverified binary download from internet
findings.message: The k8s-validate job downloads 'kubeval' from 'github.com/instrumenta/kubeval/releases/latest/download' at runtime with no checksum verification. Downloading and executing an unverified binary is a supply-chain risk.
findings.remediation: Pin the kubeval version (e.g. v0.16.1) and verify the download checksum before executing. Alternatively, use a pinned container action such as 'instrumenta/kubeval' from the GitHub Actions Marketplace.

findings.message: The 'pip-audit' command ends with '|| true', meaning dependency vulnerabilities will never block the CI pipeline. This defeats the purpose of the audit step.
findings.remediation: Remove '|| true' from the pip-audit command. If known vulnerabilities need to be ignored, use pip-audit's '--ignore-vuln' flag with explicit CVE IDs instead of blanket failure suppression.

findings.message: Both hadolint-action steps set 'no-fail: true', which means Dockerfile lint violations (including critical security rules) never block the pull request. This nullifies the linting enforcement.
findings.remediation: Set 'no-fail: false' on both hadolint-action steps (lines 64 and 71). If there are known acceptable violations, use a .hadolint.yaml ignore list rather than disabling failures globally.

findings.message: The worker-service container securityContext does not set 'readOnlyRootFilesystem: true'. Without this, a compromised container can write to the filesystem and persist malicious files.
findings.remediation: Add 'readOnlyRootFilesystem: true' to the container securityContext. Mount writable emptyDir volumes for any paths the application needs to write to (e.g. /tmp).

findings.rule: K8S-NET-001 — No NetworkPolicy defined for namespace
findings.message: No NetworkPolicy manifest was found for the 'production' namespace. Without a NetworkPolicy, all pods can communicate with each other and external endpoints by default (allow-all ingress/egress).
findings.remediation: Create a NetworkPolicy for the 'production' namespace that enforces a default-deny posture and explicitly allows only required ingress/egress traffic between services.
